bosses.name: Core Man

arenaTheme.text: Plain light grey room with a couple of small ceiling turrets. Background shall be of various size metal gears

hazardsLayer1.text: Turrets aim at player to nearest 45 deg, all firing simultaneous short 3-bullet bursts of slightly slow bullets; 15s cooldown.

hazardsLayer2.text: Same number of turrets; aim within nearest 22.5 deg; slightly reduced cooldown.

hazardsLayer3.text: Same number of turrets; aim within nearest 11.25 deg; further reduced cooldown.

attackLayer1.text: Moves back and forth on the stage, occasionally stopping to fire a 3 bullet spread with mild auto-aim after a short time, dealing small damage.

attackLayer2.text: Moves back and forth across the stage, occasionally stopping to fire either a 3 bullet spread directly forward with mild auto-aim after a short time or aim directly at the player and shoot a string of 5 bullets that do not auto aim. Boss stops tracking the player during the 5-bullet string, aiming where the player was at the time the first of 5 bullets comes out.

attackLayer3.text: Moves back and forth across the stage, occasionally stopping to fire either a set of 3 3-bullet spread directly forward with mild auto-aim after a short time or aim directly at the player, tracking the player continuously while shooting a string of 5-10 bullets that do not auto aim, either way, dealing small damage.

bosses.weaponDescription: Fires a neutral bullet with scalable fire rate; very low base damage.
bosses.lv3: Mild auto-aim. 3-bullet burst shot, like a rifle. Short cool down
bosses.lv6: Main bullet does not auto-aim; main bullet splits into 3 fragments after a brief time; fragments have moderate auto-aim. Short cooldown
bosses.lv10: full-auto with high fire rate, does not split; strong auto-aim. 0.125 cooldown

bosses.name: Blaze Man

bossAppliedAttribute.text: Hot (boss/hazard-sourced): applies only to environment; area is 'red hot'. Low transparency red hue that becomes more transparent as the effect diminishes; moderate damage/flinch/knockback on touch, scaling down until Hot subsides. Lasts 5s after the source concludes. Burn: the player is on fire. Very mild damage very rapidly, rapidly diminishing. No flinch or knockback.

weaponAppliedAttribute.text: Hot: environment only, as above; does not affect player in any way. Burn: the enemy is on fire, very mild damage very rapidly, rapidly diminishing. No flinch or knockback.

arenaTheme.text: Silhouette of a faintly glowing active volcano as the background. A few short platforms phase in and out in random places throughout the entire fight as shelter. Never shall all airborne platforms simultaneously have Hot.

hazardsLayer1.text: Brief screen shake -> occasional player-width hot flaming rocks slowly fall from top of screen, crumbling on contact with the floor or platforms, leaving Hot there for a few seconds. Moderate damage and applies Burn on player contact. Cycle repeats every 20 seconds or so.

hazardsLayer2.text: Slightly more overt screen shake -> slightly more rocks on screen, falling slightly faster, plus a couple of pits full of lava.

hazardsLayer3.text: Very overt screen shake -> a cascade of falling rocks fall nearly all at once

attackLayer1.text: Launches several bouncing fireballs toward the player that climb up walls and leave hot trails.

attackLayer2.text: Fewer fireballs, but higher bounce heights and alternating firing angles.

attackLayer3.text: Same as Layer 2; additionally, synchronized with the stage hazard, the boss jumps to a small platform just for himself a few seconds before the screen shakes, the red pixels of the background ebb rapidly, then the entire floor fills with lava, slowly, up to about one default player height; lava subsides below floor level after 6-10s, leaving Hot on the ground.

bosses.weaponDescription: Throws a small low-apogee bouncing fireball along the ground; applies Hot to ground or Burn to enemy on contact for a scalable time. High fireball contact damage, separate from Burn DPS. Player immune to player-created Hot and Burn. Hot/Burn do not stack with themselves but reset their durations.
bosses.lv1: Short travel distance; up to 1 on screen; 0.5s Hot duration.
bosses.lv3: 1s Hot duration on ground; slight increase in travel distance.
bosses.lv6: Adds a second fireball on a slightly taller, much wider arc, contacting the ground shortly after the first, approximately where the first is projected to terminate, then continuing its own equal travel. Up to 2 on screen; Hot does not stack.
bosses.lv10: Combined effective travel = full screen (half each); fireballs pierce all enemies, applying 2s Burn to each; up to 2 wheels on screen; player leaves a trail of Hot for 1s on any surface contacted

bosses.name: Tempest Man

weaponAppliedAttribute.text: Wet: the surface or enemy has been soaked in water, reducing contact friction, shown by an initially low transparency blue hue that fades until expiry. Lasts 10 seconds.

hazardsLayer1.text: Heavy rain pouring straight down applies a continuous directional force pushing the player in the direction of the rain. Steady, powerful water flows from portholes in the upper left and upper right corners, cascading down the walls and across the floor toward a grate-covered central drain/pit. Floor water knee-deep with strong inward currents pulling toward the centre; the flow drags the player toward the drain (stronger on the ground, weaker in the air). A damaging spike ball sits on top of the grate.

hazardsLayer2.text: Heavy rain cycling through one of 3 directions (top-to-bottom, diagonal down+left, diagonal down+right) applies a continuous directional force. Same porthole/drain setup; touching the grate pit deals damage.

attackLayer1.text: Slow-moving high-pressure water cannons fire water in discrete angled arcs at random times; no damage on contact, but pushes the player in the direction of the water's travel and blocks player bullets. Once it reaches the ground it continues travelling until it reaches a drain, pushing the player back; no damage.

bosses.weaponDescription: Stand still firing a continuous water stream dealing very low but highly frequent damage. Pushes the enemy; faster enemies slightly push through, slower enemies get pushed backwards.
bosses.lv1: Short travel distance; very low base damage.
bosses.lv3: Angle the attack diagonally with directional inputs. Increase travel distance accordingly.
bosses.lv6: Water stream now affected by gravity but travels significantly further overall.
bosses.lv10: Stream replaced with a semi-rapid water balloon style grenade launcher with small water-based explosions on contact with any enemy.

shared.text: Faint red hue that fades until the attribute subsides. Hot surfaces do damage/flinch/knockback to the player if touched, with hue/damage/flinch/knockback scaling down until Hot fully subsides.

bossVariant.text: Boss/hazard-sourced: player vulnerable. In Blaze Man's arena, lingers 5s after the cause concludes.

weaponVariant.text: Player-sourced (Blaze Wheel): player immune to own Hot; applied to ground/enemies for level-scaled durations.

shared.text: Faint red hue that fades until the attribute subsides. Target is on fire: rapid but weak DPS, no flinch or knockback, scaling down until the duration concludes.
The specified object has gotten soaked. Reduces contact friction; low transparency blue hue fading until expiry.
Faint purple hue. DPS applied much less often (~once every 3 seconds); causes flinch.

bossVariant.text: Toxic Cloud: lingering clouds drain health over time and reduce player speed.

weaponVariant.text: Venom Spray: damage over time; weakens enemies.

shared.text: Functionally the same as constrict/freeze; elementally correct colours flash while the target has this attribute. NOTE: distinct from FLINCH, which is the neutral hit reaction.

weaponVariant.text: Volt Spark (1s / 2s / 0.5s chained / 4s per level); Quake Hammer (nearby enemies). NOTE: this entry still credits Core Blaster, but Core Man's weapon attribute is now 'None' — tracker inconsistency, confirm which is right.

shared.text: Functionally the same as stun/freeze; elementally correct colours flash.

bossVariant.text: Vine Lash: constricts the player for several seconds before reel-in and toss.

weaponVariant.text: Thorn Lash Lv10: constricts mini-bosses, 5s DPS.

shared.text: Functionally the same as stun/constrict; elementally correct colours flash.

weaponVariant.text: Frost Guard: shield break on minion contact freezes; released icicles freeze.
